sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay of Jumping Ball revolves around shooting colored balls to match the color of the Clue Ball on top. This game is all about timing and strategy. The balls will bounce on the spinning wheel and go to the moving cap on the top, and you'll have to tap on the bottom right to change the shooting ball's color to match the color of the Clue Ball. The goal is to shoot the right ball and score points; if you shoot the wrong ball, you'll lose points. This mechanic is simple yet challenging, making it engaging and fun to play.

As you progress through the game, the difficulty will increase, and the spinning wheel will speed up, making it harder to match the colors. But don't worry, the game also provides you with power-ups to help you in your journey. For example, you can get a temporary boost to increase your score or a shield to protect you from losing points. These power-ups will add an extra layer of excitement to the game and make it even more challenging.

One of the best things about Jumping Ball is its simplicity. The controls are easy to use, and the gameplay is straightforward, making it accessible to players of all ages and skill levels.
